title: Get a closer look at the iPhone 18 Pro’s mechanical camera
summary: iFixit's teardown of the iPhone 18 Pro reveals Apple's new variable aperture lens features hair-thin magnetic blades that control light exposure while fitting in the same camera footprint as last year's model. The teardown also surfaces potential repair concerns for users and technicians.
content:
Each of those teeny lens blades is around the same thickness as a human hair. | Image: iFixit	

iFixit's latest device teardown shows us the inner workings of the new variable aperture lens inside Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, alongside some repair concerns to be mindful of. The adjustable mechanical iris opens and closes magnetically, controlling how much light should pass through to the sensor, featuring six leaf-like overlapping blades that are each about as thin as a human hair.

zh.title: 近距离了解iPhone 18 Pro的机械相机
zh.summary: iFixit对iPhone 18 Pro的拆解揭示了苹果新的可变光圈镜头，采用头发丝般纤细的磁性叶片来控制光线曝光，同时保持与去年型号相同的相机尺寸。拆解还揭示了用户和技术人员可能面临的维修隐忧。

title: UN says AI safeguards can’t wait for certainty
summary: A UN scientific panel warned that governments must implement AI safeguards before the technology's full risks are understood, elevating AI safety as a critical global diplomatic priority. The assessment reflects concerns over increasingly capable AI agents amid ongoing US-China AI negotiations.
content:
The United Nations logo at the UN headquarters in New York. | Getty Images	

Governments need to rein in increasingly capable AI agents before their risks are fully understood, a United Nations scientific panel warned in the global organization's first major assessment of OpenAI's hack of Hugging Face earlier this year.
The report cements AI's place on the global diplomatic agenda this week as leaders gather in New York for the UN General Assembly and the US and China hold talks on AI. Last week, UN secretary general António Guterres called on governments to cooperate on addressing the threats posed by AI, warning that "the world cannot afford a race to the bottom on AI safety."

zh.summary: 联合国科学小组警告称，各国政府必须在充分了解该技术风险之前实施人工智能保障措施，将人工智能安全提升为关键的全球外交优先事项。该评估反映了人们对越来越能干的人工智能代理的担忧，同时美中人工智能谈判仍在进行中。

title: Amazon doesn’t trust Meta’s Muse AI agent
summary: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse AI agent from shopping on its platform, citing unauthorized access and security concerns including the agent's failure to identify itself and potential customer credential exposure. The incident highlights growing friction between AI agent developers and e-commerce security protocols.
content:
Meta's Muse AI agent has been blocked from shopping Amazon on behalf of its users, GeekWire reports. A popup message started appearing on Sunday for Muse users saying that "continued access by an unauthorized AI agent violates Amazon's Conditions of Use, to which our customers have agreed."
According to GeekWire, Meta didn't notify Amazon that Muse would access its store. Amazon also expressed privacy and security concerns over Muse failing to identify itself when it browses, and seemingly capturing customer credentials.
